title: CommandResultMessage
description: Adjudication result of one command, produced inside the tick that adjudicated it. ACCEPTED means the server took the command into the simulation on the envelope tick - it does NOT mean the intent completed. The type-specific result (PING_REPLY, and in later slices the resulting domain events) follows separately and always after this message for the same command_id. Every command the server could attribute to a command_id gets exactly one COMMAND_RESULT; the client uses that one-to-one property to detect loss.

command_id.description: command_id of the command being answered. Echoed from the command envelope; the server treats it only as an idempotency key and never derives time or order from it.

status.description: ACCEPTED: taken into the simulation on the envelope tick. REJECTED: not taken; reason_code says why and no world state changed.

reason_code.description: Null when status is ACCEPTED, a RejectReasonCode when REJECTED. The schema cannot express that correlation (see ADR-0005 section 4); the server enforces it and invariant I-14 states it.

RejectReasonCode.title: RejectReasonCode
RejectReasonCode.description: Closed set for schema_version 1. Values may be ADDED in a later version, so consumers must treat an unknown value as 'rejected for an unknown reason' and keep running, never crash or assume acceptance.
